description: Identify the core payment timing and structure from a financial or payment-related contract clause.

problems.prompt: Analyze the provided payment clause and classify the payment terms into exactly one category from the following list: Net 30, Net 60, Net 90, Due upon receipt, Milestone-based, Annual upfront, Quarterly, Monthly, Not specified, Other. Return a single JSON object containing exactly one key: "payment_terms". The value must match one of the listed strings exactly. Output only the JSON object.

args: Payment shall be made within thirty (30) days from the date of invoice.
All fees are payable sixty (60) days following the end of the month in which the invoice is issued.
The Client agrees to remit payment no later than ninety (90) calendar days after receipt of a properly submitted invoice.
Invoices are due and payable immediately upon receipt. Late fees shall accrue after five days.
Fifty percent upon execution, twenty-five percent upon delivery of the prototype, and the balance upon final acceptance.
The annual subscription fee of $12,000 is to be paid in full at the commencement of each contract year.
License fees shall be remitted on a quarterly basis, with payments due on the first day of each calendar quarter.
Service fees are billed and payable on the first business day of each month.
The parties agree that compensation details shall be negotiated separately and documented in a future statement of work.
Payment terms are 2% 10 Net 45, with a two percent discount available if paid within ten days, otherwise the full amount is due in forty-five days.
